## Why this change is needed

Describe the problem, intended outcome, and relevant issue or decision.

## What changes

Summarize the behavior and the boundary of this PR. Name affected consumers,
interfaces, generated artifacts, or rollout dependencies when relevant.

## Evidence

Record the commands, results, and revision they support. Distinguish checks that
ran from proposed assertions, static predictions, and checks still unavailable.
Link observed client or human results only when they apply to these exact bytes.
For prompt, rubric, or agent-loop changes, identify runtime bounds, evaluation
versions, and any separate grader-calibration evidence; keep confirmed failure
cases and missing evidence visible.

## Review focus and delivery

Identify the highest-risk question, remaining uncertainty, and recovery approach.
For catalog or generated changes, include the source and manifest commits and
state any qualification that must be repeated. Preserve their ancestry with a
merge commit; a passing check does not authorize a release or deployment.

See [the review workflow](../docs/code-review-workflow.md) and
[contribution requirements](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the applicable detail.
